violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: OBSERVED MILK CRATES USED FOR THE STORAGE OF FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LIQUID CLEANING AGENTS.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink, paper towel dispenser was out of paper towels
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC moved paper towels to a temporary storage solution by the handwashing sink next

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition

violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC agreed to have dish machine repaired

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Test kit for quaternary ammonia sanitizer had expired in feb 2024
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC acquired a test kit that was not expired
